audits.original_problem: A basketball player makes free throws with probability 0.72. In a game she attempts 11 free throws. Find the probability she makes at least 9, and compute the variance of her makes.

audits.original_problem: How many sequences of +1 and -1, each of length 10 (five +1s and five -1s), have all partial sums strictly positive after the first term and equal to 0 at the end?
audits.new_problem: In how many ways can a sequence of 12 coin flips (6 heads and 6 tails) be arranged so that at every prefix of the sequence, the number of heads seen so far is greater than or equal to the number of tails seen so far?

audits.original_problem: On a 4x4 grid (from (0,0) to (4,4)), how many monotone paths stay strictly below the main diagonal (i.e., at every step, the number of R moves strictly exceeds the number of U moves)?
